sampling_note: Counts are cumulative; intervals can include pauses, menus, and inactive camera modes. No displayed-FPS claim.

navigation.cadence_note: Wrapper-entry cadence, not displayed FPS or solver execution. Suppressed for multiple sampled objects.

rigid_body.cadence_note: Wrapper-entry cadence, not displayed FPS or solver execution. Suppressed for multiple sampled objects.

script_frames.note: Paired accumulated context frames/seconds; not displayed FPS. Repeated reads are not summed.

physics_step.note: StepInfo passed to Havok collision task setup. Does not alone prove how every body is integrated.

physics_solver.note: Post-call world fields; alternate-world samples excluded from comparisons. Not proof of body trajectories.

physics_simulation.note: Implementation identity observed after collision setup. Single-threaded solving can occur inline before task submission; this does not count completed solves.
